text.tspan: We start with a gene family node catalyzing a reaction of the pathway: the 'seed' node.
We extend the closure allowing at most 2 gap node, that are gene families unrelated with the pathway
(not known to catalyz one of its reactions).
When we reach a distance of 2 gaps, we do not extend the closure.
With a maximum distance of 2 allowed gaps (the distance is parametrable)
The transitive closure path can use a shortcut via a node catalyzing a reaction of the pathway,
as it resets the counter of the depth of the node
In more detail, how is the depth computed ?
